results.title: Bronze breakthrough for Izzah as she rides to first-ever Asiad podium finish
results.description: PETALING JAYA: Nurul Izzah Izzati Mohd Asri chalked a new milestone in her growing cycling career after securing bronze in the women's keirin final at Izu Velodrome in Shizuoka today (Sept 30).
